summary: Desktop business/controller layer for Electron host setup, local-api runtime ownership, windows, protocol, menu, and IPC wiring.
architecture_notes: Keep Electron, filesystem, local-api, session, and persistence wiring here rather than in GUI packages.
Desktop connects to the profile singleton through fingerprinted host discovery. Source hosts use one direct tsx loader process by default; watcher supervision is an explicit development opt-in.
The renderer consumes injected runtime contracts and must not import these controllers.
